settings.markdown:
Welcome to the City of Sarnia's GeoHub.


This public site provides tools to explore and visualize City data using web applications and maps, download open data, and engage with important initiatives.
Find Your Data

Interactive Mapping

Explore and locate information using interactive web maps and applications

View All

Story Maps and Tours

Explore data-driven stories and tours to learn more about city initiatives and projects

View All

Contact Information

geospatial.solutions@sarnia.ca

How can you use the data?

Read the Terms of Use.

https://www.arcgis.com/sharing/rest/comm.description:
Use this group to organize the items that you want to share as part of your site. Shared items become available in your site's search results and only people who have access to these items will be able to find them. Members of the core team get access to shared items and can update them at any time. Certain cards, like the Gallery card, will automatically populate with shared items so that you don't have to search for them when choosing what you want to display on your site.

Contact support with any questions related to this group or content management for your site.

DO NOT DELETE THIS GROUP.
